title: Harrington has seen lasers that could bring down almost anything

tellings.quote: >> I mean I I have seen laser technology that could bring down almost anything.

plain: A guest presented on the show as US Secretary of Energy, John S. Herrington, says he has "seen laser technology that could bring down almost anything". He tells Michels this from his own experience, on an episode where he speaks about UFOs, suggesting the government has weapons able to stop even very advanced craft.
